purpose: Governed source identities for U.S. Employment Situation first-print actuals and point-in-time market consensus. This contract authorizes source audit/reconstruction only; it does not authorize model scoring or forecast/decision writes.
point_in_time_rule: For any event at t, a model input is eligible only when available_as_of <= t. Current-vintage substitution for historical first-print actuals or post-release consensus is forbidden.

MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.semantic: BLS Employment Situation first-published total nonfarm payroll employment monthly change
MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Situation archive
MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.availability_policy: official BLS release timestamp at 08:30 America/New_York
MACRO_NFP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.revision_policy: archive release first print; later revisions must not overwrite the archived first print

MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.semantic: BLS Employment Situation first-published unemployment rate
MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Situation archive
MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.availability_policy: official BLS release timestamp at 08:30 America/New_York
MACRO_UNEMP_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.revision_policy: archive release first print; later revisions must not overwrite the archived first print

MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.semantic: BLS Employment Situation first-published average hourly earnings month-over-month change for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls
MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Situation archive
MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.availability_policy: official BLS release timestamp at 08:30 America/New_York
MACRO_AHE_ACTUAL_FIRST_PRINT.revision_policy: prefer explicitly published MoM percent; when older release gives cents change and current level only, derive MoM transparently from those first-release fields and tag transform metadata

MACRO_NFP_CONSENSUS_PIT.semantic: Last approved pre-release market consensus for headline NFP change
MACRO_NFP_CONSENSUS_PIT.availability_policy: last approved provider snapshot strictly before official release time

MACRO_UNEMP_CONSENSUS_PIT.semantic: Last approved pre-release market consensus for unemployment rate
MACRO_UNEMP_CONSENSUS_PIT.availability_policy: last approved provider snapshot strictly before official release time

MACRO_AHE_CONSENSUS_PIT.semantic: Last approved pre-release market consensus for average hourly earnings month-over-month change
MACRO_AHE_CONSENSUS_PIT.availability_policy: last approved provider snapshot strictly before official release time
